sources.title: Rijkscultuurfondsen.org (the national cultural funds' guide for the ABCSSS islands): Production Subsidy (Performing Arts Fund NL)
sources.said: The Production Subsidy is aimed at organisations whose primary purpose is to develop, perform or re-enact professional performances, concerts or competitions. The organisation must have produced at least two professional productions or the creators must have been active as professional performing artists for at least two years . … It is possible to apply for production grants up to a maximum of 78,750 euros. However, if you are applying for a production grant for more new compositions, librettos or theatrical texts an additional grant of up to 26,250 euros is available. … There are three application rounds a year. … Your budget must meet the standard of 20% of total budget must come from your own income … Your organisation’s aim must be the production of professional performing arts and it must have legal personality … The premiere date must be at least four months after the deadline for the application round

sources.title: Rijkscultuurfondsen.org home
sources.said: Are you working in the arts and culture sector on Aruba, Bonaire, Curaçao, Saba, Sint Eustatius or Sint Maarten? You may be eligible for grants from the national government.

sources.title: Rijkscultuurfondsen.org: Cultural education for the Dutch Caribbean part of the Kingdom 2025-2028 (Cultural Participation Fund)
sources.said: Self-employed professionals with at least two years’ experience in the field of cultural education based on Curaçao, Aruba or Sint Maarten can apply for grants. The application should always be intended for collaboration between the applicant and one or more schools. … Projects €15,000 – €50,000 … We fund 100% of the total project costs. … Applications can be submitted between 2 June 2025 and 9 December 2026.

figures.finding: As item 1. The Production Subsidy page doesn't itself say a Sint Maarten organisation qualifies; the site that lists it is for the Caribbean islands ('you may be eligible'). Fonds Podiumkunsten's own Dutch eligibility text wasn't read for Sint Maarten. The Prince Bernhard Culture Fund Caribbean's address (pbccaribbean.com/podiumkunsten) redirected to a gambling site and wasn't used.
